result.topic_en: Notes on a potential-theory problem (a function u expressed as an alternating series of image terms φ(z+2nα∓β)), with Taylor expansions of the terms and a summation by an Euler–Maclaurin-type argument, plus side calculations of the form x − p = (1+1/(2p))(1−e^{-2p}) + const.
result.transcription:
In unseren bisherigen Untersuchungen über die Abgleichung [?] vorausgesetzt [?] ...
Wir haben bisher angenommen dass, um es bei der Grenzbedingung [?]
der Fall ist, die Masseneinheit eine Masseneinheit in der Entfernung
$r$ mit der Kraft $\frac{1}{rr}$
$u = \frac12 \sum (-1)^n \varphi(z+2n\alpha-\beta) - \varphi(z+2n\alpha+\beta)$
$= \frac12 \sum \varphi(z+4n\alpha-\beta) - \varphi(z+4n\alpha+\beta) - \varphi(z+4n\alpha+2\alpha-\beta) + \varphi(z+4n\alpha+2\alpha+\beta)$
$\varphi^{(m)}(4n\alpha)\frac{(z-\beta)^m}{\Pi m}$
$x - p = (1+\frac{1}{2p})(1-e^{-2p}) + \mathrm{const} = at(2p+1)$
$\frac12$ [-$\varphi^{m}(0)\frac{(z\ldots)^m}{\Pi m}$-]
$\sum_{1,\infty} \frac12 \frac{\varphi^{(m)}(0)}{\Pi(m)}\left((z-\beta)^m - (z+\beta)^m - (z+2\alpha-\beta)^m + (z-2\alpha+\beta)^m\right)$
$\sum_1 \sum \frac{\varphi^{2m}(4n\alpha)}{\Pi(2m)}\left((z-\beta)^{2m} - (z+\beta)^{2m} - (z+2\alpha-\beta)^{2m} + (z-2\alpha+\beta)^{2m}\right)$
$x = 3at+1$
$\varphi'(4n\alpha+4\alpha) = \sum_{0,\infty}\frac{\varphi^{(m+1)}(4n\alpha)}{\Pi(m)}(4\alpha)^m$
$u = 3a \qquad p=1$
[-$\varphi''(4n\alpha)4\alpha = \varphi'(4n\alpha+4\alpha) - \varphi'(4n\alpha) - \sum_{2,\infty}\frac{\varphi^{(m+1)}(4n\alpha)}{\Pi(m)}(4\alpha)^{m-1}$-]
$\varphi''(4n\alpha)4\alpha = \varphi'(4n\alpha) - \varphi'(4n\alpha-4\alpha) + \sum_{2,\infty}\frac{\varphi^{(m+1)}(4n\alpha)}{\Pi(m)}(-4\alpha)^m$
$4\alpha\sum_{1,\infty}\varphi''(4n\alpha) = -\varphi'(0) + \sum_{2,\infty}^{m}\sum_{1,\infty}^{n}\frac{\varphi^{(m+1)}(4n\alpha)}{\Pi(m)}(-4\alpha)^m$
$+\sum\frac{\varphi''(4n\alpha)}{2}\cdot(-8\alpha z)$
$\frac{1}{u} = \frac{1}{3a} \qquad \frac{1}{u} = \frac{1-e^{-2p}}{2ap}$
$-4z\beta + 4z(\beta-2\alpha)$

methods.what: Method of images: potential as alternating series of shifted source terms
Regrouping the alternating series into period-4α blocks
Taylor expansion of the image terms about 4nα (only even powers survive)
Taylor series of φ' with step 4α
Telescoping sum to express Σφ''(4nα) (Euler–Maclaurin-type summation)
Side computation relating x, p, t with exponential
